value.rationale: The result completely characterizes all pairs in the dimension-three case of an explicitly posed geometric restricted Schur–Horn problem and classifies all maximizing parallelepipeds. It supplies a coordinate-free quartic decision test, a non-principal triaxial witness and a unique-versus-continuous distinction, filling a meaningful mathematical gap rather than computing an arbitrary invariant.
